priority.override_reason: Fresh exact-current profiles closed ranks one through ten for this cycle: recursive control, HashMap, A*, Tagcloud, public-field raytrace, CDJS, darkroom, 3d-raytrace, N-body, and input validation reproduce already rejected frame, generic-dispatch, Value-lifetime, property, RegExp, helper-call, or allocation mechanisms without a new independently bounded cost. Rank-eleven Gaussian blur changes that evidence: after the retained guarded unary-Math opcode removed the former call hotspot, 37.4% remains in generic dispatch and the source-faithful bytecode has four nested numeric backedges but zero typed-loop programs. A reverted compiler diagnostic identifies two coupled whitelist gaps in the same innermost region: the logical-or boundary emits JumpIfTrue, and kernel[row] must remain boxed to serve as the receiver of the second dense index. This unit admits that general branchy nested-dense region rather than retrying Math, generic compact dispatch, dense scalar-leaf, numeric-helper graph, or object-field scalarization mechanisms.

mechanism.summary: Admit numeric typed-loop regions that combine truthy short-circuit branches with nested dense-array reads. Lower JumpIfTrue through the existing typed truthiness operation and falsy branch representation. During the compiler's convergent class-learning passes, record a dense element read whose result is later required as a property receiver and recompile that site to the existing boxed ElementRead operation; the following index then stays boxed until its numeric consumer unboxes it. Each array access retains its own runtime dense-array, integer-index, present-element, and value-class guard, and any miss deoptimizes at the original bytecode site with the exact operand stack. The expected Gaussian-blur reduction is at least 35%; reject the unit unless the target reaches at most 0.65x its exact base and every declared control remains at most 1.03x. Scope is the private typed-loop compiler, IR execution tests, and no parser, AST, public API, dependency, environment-model, generic VM dispatch, or specialized numeric-mutation tier change.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility is derived only from ordinary bytecode dataflow inside an otherwise admitted typed-loop region. A truthy branch is accepted for every typed Number, Boolean, or undefined condition using the same ToBoolean rule as the existing falsy branch. A nested element chain is learned only when an earlier computed read must remain boxed for a later property read; each receiver must be a live Array and each key a present non-negative integer dense element at execution. The mechanism never inspects source paths, benchmark names, variable names, function identities, array dimensions, input values, loop counts, checksums, or results. Strings, objects requiring coercion, holes, accessors, indexed descriptors, inherited indexed properties, Proxies, non-Arrays, out-of-range keys, unsupported calls, writes through the receiver binding, direct eval, and every class or control-flow mismatch leave through the existing precise deoptimization path.
semantic_risks: JumpIfTrue must preserve the original condition on the operand stack while branching on exact ECMAScript truthiness for every typed value, including NaN and signed zero
an out-of-region truthy exit must invert only the branch decision and still materialize the original pre-branch stack at the bytecode target
boxed-element class discovery must converge monotonically with existing boxed-local discovery and must not change an unrelated scalar dense read
the first nested property read must preserve key evaluation order and leave a real boxed array value available if a later Math guard or second index deoptimizes
holes, accessors, indexed descriptors, inherited properties, Proxies, non-integer keys, and non-Array intermediate values must deopt before suppressing observable property semantics
the final numeric consumer may unbox only Number, Boolean, or undefined values already representable by the typed register file and must replay other values at the original site
forward and backward joins must agree on boxed register class, origin, and exact deoptimization stack after truthy and falsy paths merge
typed-loop precedence over specialized loop tiers and the boxed-operation profitability guard must remain unchanged for every previously admitted or rejected region
